context: M23 o2. The Arden's boiler room, rain drumming on the street grate above.

lines.speaker: char.marcus_teague
lines.text: Miss Moore. Ricky talked. Brannock knows the box isn't in your room.

lines.speaker: char.marcus_teague
lines.text: He doesn't know it's here. Yet. Ricky's still thinking.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Then we move it tonight. To the only other bank on the West Side that's ours.

lines.speaker: char.marcus_teague
lines.text: Back stairs are open, Miss Moore. They're always open for you.
